questions.question: What is the effect of a rise in the real exchange rate on domestic exports?
questions.explanation: The speaker states that a higher real exchange rate makes domestic goods more expensive, leading to a decline in exports (see Q0015, Q0018).

questions.explanation: When the real exchange rate rises, foreign goods become cheaper relative to domestic goods, so imports increase (see Q0018).

questions.question: Why does net exports decline when the real exchange rate rises?
questions.answer: Because domestic goods become relatively more expensive, reducing export demand and increasing import demand.
questions.explanation: The lecture links a higher real exchange rate to higher domestic prices relative to foreign prices, which lowers exports and raises imports, thus reducing net exports (see Q0015, Q0018).
